title: 第13章 八十九牛之力第14章 剑魔传承
content_zh:
“这是剑魔之心的精血，既是饱含着归元剑体的血脉，也蕴含着剑魔的力量。”
神秘人拂袖，血剑咻地一声没入秦玄体内，他正色道：“小子，马上运转《万化混沌诀》炼化了这团血液。”
不用神秘人开口，秦玄都肯定会这样做，因为血剑入体的那一刻，仿佛化作了亿万利剑，疯狂地在他四肢百骸肆虐，仿佛要将他所有一切都摧毁殆尽般，有着无尽的痛苦。
要知道，如今他已然觉醒了万道神体，并且达至了炼体境极境，肉身力量十万斤，体魄堪称强横无匹，比起无数真武境还要更强。
但在这团剑魔真血面前，依旧脆弱无比。
浑身毛孔源源不断地渗透出鲜血，眨眼间就将他染成了一个血人。
秦玄紧咬牙关，忍受无尽的痛苦，开始运转《万化混沌诀》，与万道神体发生共鸣。
顿时间，本来欲要将他活活撑爆的剑魔真血无尽能量，一下子被《万化混沌诀》抽调去了超过九成，去了未知之处。
剩余下来的一成剑魔真血虽然依旧很恐怖，但起码秦玄还能勉强承受，开始缓缓地停下来，并且缓缓地按照相关的玄功路线，在体内经脉游走起来。
自然，剑魔真血游走经脉间，秦玄分明感受到，经脉难以承受，不断地被撕裂开，产生剧烈的痛苦。
这一切，他都生生地忍受下来，因为感受到那股剑魔真血在游走全身四肢百骸间，不断地与身体产生一丝丝联系，也在潜移默化地改变着他的身躯，一股股沛然的力量从剑魔真血中散发出来，修复伤势。
就这样，剑魔真血一方面在其四肢百骸运转，撕裂经脉、血肉、筋骨，另一方面也释放强大的生机，进行修复。
秦玄的身躯，陷入了破坏与修复的循环中。
几乎每过一个呼吸，他的肉身就会比起之前更强一截，但也会迅速崩坏，然后进行修复。
如此循环中，不知道过去了多久之后，终于，秦玄感觉到这团剑魔真血彻底融入了自己的体内。
并且，破境了！
这一刻，秦玄睁开双眸，眸子开阖间有如剑锋芒在吞吐，射出了两道足足数尺长的眸光，撞击在塔壁上，铿锵作响。
他长身而起，身上衣衫早就在一次次破坏修复中被撕裂开，此刻瞬间化作齑粉，显露出强健有力的虎躯，身姿修长而挺拔。
每一寸肌肉都蕴含着恐怖性的力量，通体筋骨散发着噼里啪啦的声响，肉身比起早前强大了一大截，充满了力量，远胜此前不知何几。
重新取出一套黑袍披在身上。

此刻，秦玄清晰地感应到自己目前的力量，本来处于炼体境极限，拥有十万斤力量。
也就是十牛之力。
但现在，浑身血气滚滚，血液在体内四肢百骸流淌间，宛若是洪水冲刷，散发开震耳欲聋的声响。
丹田中，仿佛一片小天地，一股股灰蒙蒙的元力在沉淀着，散发着惊人的气息，开始爆发。
一头头魁梧高大的蛮牛虚影正在体外浮现而出。
十一头，十二头，十三头……
三十头……
五十头……
八十头……
眨眼间，浮现出的蛮牛虚影就冲破了八十一头的九九极限了，还在持续不断地增加。
须知道，寻常真武境武修的力量极限，不过是九牛之力，也就是九万斤巨力。
然而，秦玄在炼体境便达到了传说中的炼体境极境，足足十万斤之巨，乃是十牛之力，比起一般的真武境极限都要更强。
如今，突破成为真武境后，力量自然更强。
content_en:
"This is the essence and blood of the sword demon's heart. It contains both the blood of the Guiyuan sword body and the power of the sword demon."
The mysterious man flicked his sleeves, and the blood sword sank into Qin Xuan's body with a whoosh. He said seriously: "Boy, immediately run the "Ten Thousand Transformations Chaos Art" to refine this mass of blood."
No need for the mysterious man to speak, Qin Xuan would definitely do this, because the moment the blood sword entered his body, it seemed to turn into billions of swords, raging crazily on his limbs and bones, as if to destroy everything in him, causing endless pain.
You must know that now he has awakened the Ten Thousand Dao Divine Body and reached the extreme realm of body refining. His physical strength is one hundred thousand kilograms, and his physique is unparalleled, even stronger than countless true martial arts realms.
But in front of this ball of sword demon true blood, he is still extremely fragile.
Blood seeped out from the pores all over his body, turning him into a bloody man in the blink of an eye.
Qin Xuan gritted his teeth, endured endless pain, and began to operate the "Ten Thousand Transformations Chaos Art" to resonate with the Ten Thousand Dao Divine Body.
In a moment, the endless energy of the sword demon's true blood, which was about to burst him alive, was suddenly diverted by more than 90% of the "Ten Thousand Transformations Chaos Art" and went to an unknown place.
Although the remaining 10% of the Sword Demon's true blood was still terrifying, at least Qin Xuan could barely bear it and began to slowly stop, and slowly started to swim through the meridians in his body according to the relevant Xuan Gong route.
Naturally, the sword demon's true blood traveled through the meridians, and Qin Xuan clearly felt that the meridians were unbearable and were being torn open continuously, causing severe pain.
He endured all of this because he felt the Sword Demon's true blood flowing through his body, limbs, and bones, constantly connecting with his body, and subtly changing his body. A stream of powerful power emanated from the Sword Demon's true blood, repairing injuries.
In this way, on the one hand, the Sword Demon's true blood circulates in its limbs and bones, tearing apart the meridians, flesh and bones, and on the other hand, it also releases powerful vitality for repair.
Qin Xuan's body fell into a cycle of destruction and repair.
With almost every breath, his physical body becomes stronger than before, but it also quickly breaks down and then repairs.
After an unknown amount of time passed in this cycle, Qin Xuan finally felt that the true blood of the Sword Demon had completely integrated into his body.
And, it’s broken!
At this moment, Qin Xuan opened his eyes, and his eyes opened and closed like the sharp edge of a sword, shooting out two rays of light that were several feet long, hitting the tower wall with a clanging sound.
He stood up. His clothes had long been torn apart during repeated damage and repairs. At this moment, he instantly turned into powder, revealing a strong and powerful tiger body, with a slender and straight posture.
Every inch of muscle contains terrifying power, and the whole body's muscles and bones make crackling sounds. The physical body is much stronger than before, full of power, far greater than before.
He took out another set of black robes and put them on.
At this moment, Qin Xuan clearly sensed that his current strength was originally at the limit of the body refining realm, with a strength of one hundred thousand kilograms.
That is the power of ten oxen.
But now, the blood is flowing all over the body, and the blood is flowing through the limbs and bones in the body, like a flood, emitting a deafening sound.
In the dantian, it was like a small world, with streams of gray Yuan Power settling, exuding an astonishing aura, and began to explode.
The phantoms of tall and burly bulls are emerging from outside the body.
Eleven heads, twelve heads, thirteen heads...
Thirty heads...
Fifty heads...
Eighty heads...
In the blink of an eye, the number of phantoms of wild bulls that emerged exceeded the limit of eighty-one and was still increasing.
It must be understood that the limit of strength of ordinary Zhenwu Realm martial arts cultivators is only the power of nine oxen, which is a huge force of ninety thousand kilograms.
However, Qin Xuan reached the legendary extreme level of body refining in the body refining realm, weighing a hundred thousand kilograms, which is the power of ten bulls. Compared withGenerally, the limit of the True Martial Realm is stronger.
Now, after breaking through to the True Martial Realm, his strength will naturally be stronger.
